name: Retailer Service 1 Code
definition: List of Retail services available and used in the Retail messages. Helps to know which service to activate.

DCAQ.name: Device Send Application Protocol Data Unit Card Reader Request
DCAQ.definition: A service to send commands to a card.

ADAQ.name: Administrative Admin Request
ADAQ.definition: An administrative request, to select and start customised administrative services provided by the POI, using a "menu" for an interactive or software interface, initiated by the Sale system.

ADAP.name: Administrative Admin Response
ADAP.definition: The POI System responds to an administrative request.

RPAP.name: Administrative Report Get Totals Response
RPAP.definition: The POI System responds to a totals figures request.

RPAQ.name: Administrative Report Get Totals Request
RPAQ.definition: The Sale System requests to the POI System a report on the totals figures of the POI system.

RPTQ.name: Administrative Report Transaction Request
RPTQ.definition: The Sale System requests to the POI System a report on a list of transactions.

RPTP.name: Administrative Report Transaction Response
RPTP.definition: The POI System responds to a transaction report request.

SMDQ.name: Administrative Session Management Diagnosis Request
SMDQ.definition: The Sale System requests a session diagnosis to the POI System.

SMDP.name: Administrative Session Management Diagnosis Response
SMDP.definition: The POI System responds to a diagnosis request.

SMIQ.name: Administrative Session Management Login Request
SMIQ.definition: The Sale System requests a login to the POI System.

SMIP.name: Administrative Session Management Login Response
SMIP.definition: The POI System responds to a login request.

SMOQ.name: Administrative Session Management Logout Request
SMOQ.definition: The Sale System requests a logout to the POI System.

SMOP.name: Administrative Session Management Logout Response
SMOP.definition: The POI System responds to a logout request.

DDYQ.name: Device Display Request
DDYQ.definition: One System requests the other to display a message for cashier or customer.

DDYP.name: Device Display Response
DDYP.definition: One system responds to the other system for a display request.

DCIQ.name: Device Initialisation Card Reader Request
DCIQ.definition: Service to send parameters to use when card reader initializes a new communication with the card.

DCIP.name: Device Initialisation Card Reader Response
DCIP.definition: The POI system responds to the Sale System for a card reader initialisation.

DINO.name: Device Input Notification
DINO.definition: One system sends a notification to the POI System to update a input request.

DINQ.name: Device Input Request
DINQ.definition: One system requests to the other System to get data input.

DINP.name: Device Input Response
DINP.definition: One system responds to the other System for a input request.

DSOQ.name: Device Play Sound Request
DSOQ.definition: One system requests to the Other System to play a sound.

DSOP.name: Device Play Sound Response
DSOP.definition: One system responds to the other System for a play sound request.

DCPQ.name: Device Power Off Card Reader Request
DCPQ.definition: The Sale system requests to the POI System to power off the card reader.

DCPP.name: Device Power Off Card Request Response
DCPP.definition: The POI system responds to the Sale System for a card reader power off.

DPRQ.name: Device Print Request
DPRQ.definition: One system requests to the other System to print data.

DPRP.name: Device Print Response
DPRP.definition: One system responds to the other System for a print request.

DSIQ.name: Device Secure Input Request
DSIQ.definition: One system requests to the Other System to securely get data input (e.g. for PIN).

DSIP.name: Device Secure Input Response
DSIP.definition: One system responds to the other System for secure data input.

DCAP.name: Device Send Application Protocol Data Unit Card Reader Response
DCAP.definition: The POI system responds to the Sale System for a card reader Application Protocol Data Unit sending.

DCOQ.name: Device Transmission Message Request
DCOQ.definition: The Sale system requests to the POI System to transmit a message (for instance to a mobile server).

DCOP.name: Device Transmission Message Response
DCOP.definition: The POI system responds to the Sale System after a message transmission.

FSIQ.name: Financial Balance Inquiry Request
FSIQ.definition: The Sale System requests to the POI System to perform balance inquiry on the main account.

FSIP.name: Financial Balance Inquiry Response
FSIP.definition: The POI System sends a response to a Balance Inquiry request.

FSBQ.name: Financial Batch Request
FSBQ.definition: The Batch message pair is used to request or get the result of transactions (payment, loyalty and reversal) performed without connection to the Sale system (Payment delivery).

FSBP.name: Financial Batch Response
FSBP.definition: The POI System sends a response to a batch processing request.

FSAQ.name: Financial Card Acquisition Request
FSAQ.definition: The Sale System requests to the POI System to handle a card data acquisition on the card reader.

FSAP.name: Financial Card Acquisition Response
FSAP.definition: The POI System sends a response to a card data acquisition request.

FSEQ.name: Financial Enable Service Request
FSEQ.definition: The Sale System requests to the POI System to enable a service on its side.

FSEP.name: Financial Enable Service Response
FSEP.definition: The POI System sends a response after enabling or not some service.

FSLQ.name: Financial Loyalty Request
FSLQ.definition: The Sale System requests to the POI System a loyalty service like loading or redeem.

FSLP.name: Financial Loyalty Response
FSLP.definition: The POI System sends a response to a loyalty processing request.

FSPQ.name: Financial Payment Request
FSPQ.definition: The Sale System requests to the POI System to perform a payment(Purchase/Refund/PWCB/MOTO Payment/...).

FSPP.name: Financial Payment Response
FSPP.definition: The POI System sends a response to a payment request (Purchase/refund/PWCB/MOTO Payment/...).

FSCQ.name: Financial Reconciliation Request
FSCQ.definition: The Sale System request to the POI System different kinds of transaction reconciliation.

FSCP.name: Financial Reconciliation Response
FSCP.definition: The POI System sends a response to a reconciliation request.

FSRQ.name: Financial Reversal Request
FSRQ.definition: The Sale System requests to the POI System to perform a reversal partial or complete to cancel a former payment service.

FSRP.name: Financial Reversal Response
FSRP.definition: The POI System sends a response to a reversal request.

FSVQ.name: Financial Stored Value Request
FSVQ.definition: The Sale System requests to the POI System to manage a stored value card or account (eg. Load, Payment, Reimbursement).

FSVP.name: Financial Stored Value Response
FSVP.definition: The POI System sends a response to a stored value card or account request.

SSAB.name: System Abort
SSAB.definition: Abort a former request or message by the sale system.

SSEN.name: System Event Notification
SSEN.definition: Send an Event notification to the other party.

SSRR.name: System Message Rejection
SSRR.definition: Send a rejection for a previous message.

SSSQ.name: System Message Status Request
SSSQ.definition: The Sale System requests to the POI System the status of a previous transaction.

SSSP.name: System Message Status Response
SSSP.definition: The POI System responds to a message status request.
